## Summary

Adds `working-documents/agent-identity-accountability-attributes.md`, a contribution to #50 (agent identity in telemetry): one attribute group, `agent.accountability.*` (result, reference, assurance), what the record behind the reference holds, and four redaction rules beside the rule proposed in #50. No row of the agent identity table proposed in #50 is changed.

## Related Issue

Updates #50, as agreed on the thread on 2026-11-09; it does not close it. The attribute table and the asynchronous trace are @wlad232's: when he opens his PR, this text can be folded into it as a section and this PR closed.

## Review Notes

- The redaction rules (section 4) are co-owned with Security & Privacy, as #50 asks for its sanitisation guidelines. This PR stays in draft until S&P has reviewed them; @npgovintarajan, as author of #50 and S&P liaison, could you say who takes that review?
- Fit with #67 and open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai#239: `agent.accountability.ref` is a span-to-record reference of the kind seam 1 of #67 describes, with two limits: it does not resolve outside the deciding party, and it is not exported outside that party's trust domain. Open question 4 asks whether the table states this as a difference from the `_ref` pattern of open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai#490 or adopts its syntax.
- Open questions for the group are in section 5.

Suggested review window, if different from the defaults: the default for living documents (1 week).

## Follow-ups

- Fold into the attribute-table PR when it is open.
- S&P review of section 4.
- Align attribute names and namespace with the OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions before any upstream proposal.
